text:
sam: FYI I opened a migration guide PR to clarify batching_hint behavior and update SDK examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/489

lina: quick skim  what's the specific ambiguity?

sam: docs currently show examples with batching_hint: 'auto' in code blocks. Our SDK examples usually omit it. Need to confirm runtime defaults across Hosted, Dedicated, Private so examples don't mislead.

ken: SDK lead here  we intentionally leave the param out when it matches runtime default. Putting 'auto' in snippets causes copy-paste mistakes for Dedicated users.

ci-bot: docs-preview: build started for PR #489. Preview URL: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/489

ci-bot: linkcheck: FAIL  found internal-only URL in migration guide: http://internal.redwood.local/batching-spec. Marked as blocked.

devin: runtime defaults: Hosted + Private control plane default to 'auto'. Dedicated default is 'manual' unless pool has adaptive batching enabled. So yes, behavior is environment-dependent.

lina: good to know. For the migration guide we should call that out explicitly so customers migrating to Dedicated aren't surprised.

sam: options for docs: show examples that omit batching_hint and add a callout about environment defaults, or show three explicit examples for each environment. Thoughts?

ken: prefer omit + callout. Also add a short example comment showing how to force a value, e.g. // batching_hint: 'manual'. Keeps SDK examples consistent.

sam: will do that. I'll replace the internal link with the public spec link and push.

ci-bot: accessibility: code block in JS example missing language tag (add ```js).

sam: thanks, will add language fence and push.

ops-bot: merge-window check: next available docs merge slot is Thu 11:00 PT. Please request slot if you need it.

lina: can we get runtime signoff from devin or someone in infra? I can review wording but need confirmation on Dedicated pool phrasing.

devin: confirming phrasing: "Hosted and Private control plane default to 'auto'; Dedicated pools default to 'manual' unless adaptive batching is enabled on the pool." That wording is fine.

sam: pushed updates: removed internal link, added public link, omitted batching_hint in examples, added code comment for forcing the field, added callout about environment defaults, added ```js fences.

ci-bot: preview updated: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/489

ci-bot: linkcheck: OK. accessibility: OK.

docs-bot: PR #489 status: awaiting approvals (0/2). Reviewers requested: @ken @devin.

ken: reviewing now, small nit on phrasing around "adaptive batching": suggest linking to Dedicated admin guide.

sam: added link to Dedicated admin guide.

devin: LGTM for technical accuracy.

lina: LGTM for doc tone. left one tiny grammar suggestion but non-blocking.

docs-bot: PR #489 status: approvals received (2/2).

sam: requesting merge window for Thu 11:00 PT now. ops-bot: please confirm slot.

ops-bot: merge slot confirmed: Thu 11:00 PT. Remember to bump changelog if needed.

sam: thanks all  removing blocker label. Will follow up if anything else pops up before merge.
